rules.name: Station High Wind Watch
rules.description: Wind speeds exceeding 50 km/h require tethered outdoor movement and securing scientific mast arrays.

rules.name: Station Severe Storm / Catabatic Gale
rules.description: Catabatic wind storm above 80 km/h triggers immediate station perimeter lockdown and shelter-in-place.

rules.name: Station Extreme Wind Gusts
rules.description: Catastrophic wind gusts exceeding 95 km/h capable of damaging antenna radomes and mobile shelters.

rules.name: Station Extreme Frostbite Warning
rules.description: Deep freeze below -35°C poses rapid skin frostbite within 5 minutes of exposure.

rules.name: Station Super-Cold Red Alert
rules.description: Life-critical deep freeze below -50°C. Diesel fuel gelation hazard and metal embrittlement.

rules.name: Station Whiteout / Near-Zero Visibility
rules.description: Whiteout optical disorientation conditions. Total outdoor traverse forbidden.

rules.name: Polar Whiteout Blizzard (Combined Triple Hazard)
rules.description: Combined wind >=55 km/h, visibility <=400m, and temperature <=-25°C forms severe Antarctic Blizzard.

rules.name: Vessel Moderate/Rough Sea Swell
rules.description: Significant wave height exceeding 4.0m in the Roaring Forties requires container lashing inspections.

rules.name: Vessel Dangerous Sea State & Severe Swell
rules.description: Extreme sea state exceeding 6.5m waves risking cargo shift and green water on weather deck.

rules.name: Vessel Gale / Storm Force Oceanic Winds
rules.description: Oceanic gale winds >75 km/h require course deviation and vessel ballast optimization.

rules.name: Marine Freezing Spray & Structural Icing
rules.description: Sub-zero temperatures combined with high wind (>45 km/h) cause severe structural superstructure icing.

rules.name: Southern Ocean Severe Storm Force (Combined)
rules.description: Combined wind >=70 km/h and wave height >=5.5m represents high-risk maritime survival conditions.
